_about: The troll camps of the home town that are laid out by the Flash client's own code (QuestsInMap ids 0-6, 8, 10, 12), as data in our own schema, read from the original (rules/camps.ts uses it; CLIENT.md, 'Troll camps'). Tiles are on the 100 x 100 home map; a piece's (x, y) is its anchor, the corner with the largest x and y. Square camps (kind 'square') are built by rules (camps.ts); layout camps (kind 'layout') put each of 'items' at the layout's origin plus (dx, dy), its id chosen by its role: wall, tower, house and unit become the enemy race's own for the player's level (levelTables), deco keeps its 'template' id, chest becomes the camp's chest. 'freed': the units a prison gives when it opens (villager: one of the player's villagers). 'popup': localization_strings ids for the camp's start and end windows; 'popupImage': images_new/ pictures by the player's race; 'infoTip': the line shown for its chest.
